title: Manager, FSI Deal Transformation and Post-Merger Integration Advisory
description:
Location: Zurich
Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100%

Help our clients successfully manage global challenges

Our Swiss market-leading FSI Deal Transformation and Post-Merger Integration Team advises Swiss Corporate and mid-market clients to generate and create value from their Mergers & Acquisitions, Divestitures, and Carve-outs. With a dedicated team of FSI experts, we deliver integration and separation advisory services, leading complex engagements with our clients, and deploying deep functional expertise in finance, human resources, commercial, and technology.

At Deloitte, we support our clients on end-to-end M&A advisory, working closely with our colleagues from transaction services, valuations, and corporate finance. As part of the Strategy, Risk and Transactions Business Line, we further collaborate with our Strategy, Sustainability, Regulatory and Forensics and Technology peers to ensure a seamless and value-driven approach to transactions.

How you will make an impact

M&A Integration and Separation leadership: bring a forward-looking approach and tailored methodologies to client situations, to lead complex M&A separations and integrations.
M&A value creation: perform and oversee operational and financial analysis to assess synergies, the impact and complexities of carve-outs, and the stand-alone performance improvement potential of buyouts and corporate divestments.
Exceptional client service: advise clients across Deloitte’s offerings, building and maintaining strong relationships, while leading the engagement teams to deliver exceptional client service, adhering to quality and robust methodology.
C-suite intimacy: develop your ability to lead conversations with client CXOs, articulating ideas into tangible solutions, and becoming the client’s go-to contact for delivery transformation.
Project scope and delivery: define, plan, resource, and execute project scope; manage expectations and timelines with clients, ensuring high-quality deliverables.
Team leadership and development: inspire and guide team members to achieve their full potential, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and excellence in project execution.
Analytical and AI solutions: provide strategic insights, advice and deploy advanced analytical and AI solutions.

Who we are looking for

Demonstrated FSI experience, entrepreneurial mindset, self-starter attitude, highly motivated to lead and grow, with ability to work independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with tight deadlines and evolving priorities.
Strong problem-solving capabilities with a focus on strategic decision-making and attention to detail, alongside a proven ability to simplify complex concepts, create executive-level narratives, and synthesise value effectively.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from top-tier universities with exceptional academic marks.
Minimum of 7 years of relevant M&A experience in consulting or industry roles, with clear experience in one of our main sectors, i.e., banking, wealth management, and insurance.  
Strong acumen for project and stakeholder management, with high-quality skills in Excel, PowerPoint and executive storytelling.
Aptitude with AI technologies and a keen interest in embedding AI solutions into our offerings to enhance client outcomes and drive innovation.
Fluent in English, with excellent interpersonal skills and experience working within an international community. Language proficiency in German is desired.

Joining our team

You’ll become part of a friendly, diverse, and highly motivated team. We will help you develop both personally and professionally through on-the-job learning, mentoring and high-quality trainings, but also through working with peers across diverse offering portfolios. At Deloitte, we are committed to a strong feedback culture, to ensure our talent is exposed to a wide and global professional environment and continuous learning.  

Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact.

At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact.

In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn.

Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.apply.deloitte.ch

How to apply

We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates.

If you have any questions, please contact Lucrezia at talent@deloitte.ch

Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today.

We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position.

title: HR Business Analyst - Workday HCM Support Specialist
description:
HR Business Analyst \- Workday HCM Support Specialist  
Join an international organisation in Basel and play a key role in supporting and enhancing its Workday HR landscape as part of an ongoing HR modernisation programme.  
HR Business Analyst \- Workday HCM Support Specialist  
Job description:  
As an HR Business Analyst – Workday HCM, you will support the day\-to\-day operation and continued development of the organisation's HR systems, with a strong focus on Workday HCM.  
Working closely with HR, HRIS, technical teams and business stakeholders, you will coordinate system changes, incidents and releases while supporting testing, training and continuous improvement. You will help ensure new and enhanced functionality is successfully transitioned into business\-as\-usual operations and provides an intuitive experience for end users.  
About the customer:  
Location: Basel, Switzerland  
Start: ASAP  
Duration: Until , with possible extension  
Workload: 100%  
Requirements:  
Provide 2nd/3rd level Workday support, troubleshooting system and HR data issues and coordinating resolution with functional and technical teams.  
Configure and maintain Workday functionality, processes, workflows and rules in line with business requirements.  
Gather and translate HR requirements into effective system enhancements and solutions.  
Coordinate incident management, including escalation, stakeholder communication, root cause analysis and follow\-up actions.  
Lead and coordinate change and release management, including Workday's bi\-annual global releases, readiness, dependencies, risks and post\-release reviews.  
Plan and execute functional, integration and UAT testing, including test preparation, documentation and issue resolution.  
Support Workday modules including Core HCM, Compensation, Advanced Compensation, Benefits, Recruiting, Performance, Talent, Time and Absence.  
Develop and deliver user training, guidance and communications for new functionality and HR processes.  
Translate technical system changes into clear, practical information for HR and end users.  
Partner with HR teams to maintain data integrity and resolve process and system issues.  
Support the wider HR systems landscape, including ServiceNow HR, and identify opportunities to improve processes and the end\-user experience.  
Analyse the downstream impact of system changes and support mitigation and continuous improvement activities.  
Competences:  
At least 3 years of relevant experience within HR, HRIS or HR Operations, ideally as a Business Analyst or HRIS Specialist.  
Strong hands\-on experience with Workday HCM and familiarity with other HR systems such as ServiceNow HR.  
Experience providing end\-user and ideally 2nd/3rd level HRIS support.  
Experience with Workday reporting and analytics, including customised reports and dashboards.  
Proven experience supporting functional and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).  
Experience creating and delivering training content for HR processes and systems.  
Comfortable managing sensitive HR processes, confidential data and data\-quality issues.  
Experience with incident, change and/or release management within an HR systems environment.  
Strong technology skills across Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint.  
Excellent English communication and stakeholder management skills.  
Analytical, organised and proactive, with strong attention to detail and a customer\-focused approach.  
Nice to Have  
Experience with ServiceNow HR implementation or support.  
Broader knowledge of HR service delivery, HR compliance and GDPR.  
Previous involvement in Workday implementations, Hypercare or HR transformation programmes. jpid192930fjm jit0833jm jiy26jm

Ihre Aufgaben:  
Betreuung von Patientinnen im stationären, ambulanten und notfallmedizinischen Bereich  
Selbstständige operative Tätigkeit mit Schwerpunkt auf endoskopischen Eingriffen  
Mitarbeit in der Geburtshilfe inklusive Beteiligung am Dienstbetrieb  
Fachliche Supervision und Unterstützung von Assistenzärztinnen und Assistenzärzten  
Mitwirkung an der Weiterbildung des ärztlichen Nachwuchses  
Beteiligung an organisatorischen und qualitätssichernden Aufgaben innerhalb der Klinik  
Ihre Kompetenzen:  
Facharzttitel Gynäkologie und Geburtshilfe oder eine in der Schweiz anerkennungsfähige Qualifikation  
Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in einer oberärztlichen Funktion  
Freude an operativer Gynäkologie, insbesondere an minimalinvasiven Verfahren  
Interesse an Ausbildung, Teaching und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit  
Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens Niveau B2  
Auch geeignet für Fachärztinnen und Fachärzte aus Deutschland, die den Wechsel in die Schweiz planen  
Ihre Vorteile:  
Breites gynäkologisches und geburtshilfliches Tätigkeitsspektrum  
Kombination aus operativer Gynäkologie und Geburtshilfe  
Eingespieltes Team mit wertschätzender Zusammenarbeit und klaren Zuständigkeiten

title: Senior Project Manager - Operations and Value Chain (m/f/d) (80-100%)
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Are you an experienced project leader with a passion for developing and optimizing manufacturing and logistics sites? Do you thrive in cross-functional environments where strategic planning, operational excellence, and hands-on project execution go hand in hand? If so, this is your opportunity to shape the future of our manufacturing footprint.


As Senior Project Manager – Operations and Value Chain, you will lead strategic site development initiatives across our manufacturing and logistics footprint, with a strong focus on projects in Switzerland. From site expansions and relocations to operational improvement initiatives, you will manage complex projects from strategic concept through hands-on execution.


Working closely with operations, logistics, engineering, infrastructure, and business leaders, you will coordinate cross-functional initiatives, support strategic investment decisions, and ensure alignment with long-term business objectives. With your structured, pragmatic, and execution-oriented approach, you will deliver measurable improvements and help strengthen the efficiency, competitiveness, and future readiness of our operations.


You will join the Supply & Value Chain Excellence organization in Baden, reporting to the Team Lead Value Chain Investments, and collaborate closely with experts and senior stakeholders across our global manufacturing network to shape the future of our operations.


Your responsibilities:

Lead strategic site development projects across manufacturing and logistics

Manage complex cross-functional projects involving operations, logistics, engineering and infrastructure

Drive projects end-to-end, from strategic concept through hands-on execution

Lead high-priority operational improvement and site-related initiatives from concept to implementation

Coordinate internal and external stakeholders and ensure alignment with business objectives

Support investment decisions through scenario evaluations, business cases and strategic assessments

Lead unplanned or high-impact special projects requiring senior project management expertise

Act as a trusted partner for internal stakeholders and ensure close collaboration between production, logistics, engineering, supply chain, and site management


Your background:

University degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or similiar

8+ years of experience in Operations, Manufacturing or Supply Chain

Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional projects from concept through execution within an industrial manufacturing environment

Experience in site development projects within manufacturing and logistics environments

Strong analytical and conceptual skills combined with a pragmatic, solution-oriented, and results-driven mindset

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across all organizational levels

Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on execution

High level of initiative, curiosity, and continuous improvement mindset combined with strong teamwork capabilities

Fluent in English and German (written and spoken)

Attractive compensation & benefits

Employee Assistance Program

Global Parental Leave Program

Flexible working models.

description:
OT Development Lead \- Digital Controls \& Architecture (100%, f/m/d)  
Rieter is the world’s leading system supplier for processing natural and man\-made fibers into short\-staple and long\-staple yarn, as well as for the production of filament yarns, man\-made fibers and nonwovens. With its comprehensive technology portfolio, Rieter covers the entire textile value chain – from fiber to yarn, and from polymer melt to texturized filament, synthetic staple fibers and nonwoven. Headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, the company designs and engineers complex spinning plants, machines, systems, and components that enable an efficient and economical production. Rieter’s leading technologies ensure minimal resource consumption, making a significant contribution to sustainability across the global textile value chain. Rieter has a history spanning more than 230 years, operates 17 production sites in nine countries, and employs around 4 220 people worldwide, approximately 15\.4% of them in Switzerland. Rieter is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange under the ticker symbol RIEN.  
OT Development Lead – Digital Controls \& Architecture (100%, f/m/d)  
To realise our vision of the fully automated, digitally orchestrated spinning mill, we are strengthening our control systems and OT development capabilities in Winterthur.  
We are looking for a hands?on OT leader who enjoys building and guiding a team of developers and architects, and who wants to actively shape Rieter’s digital and AI future on the shopfloor.  
Your Tasks  
Lead and develop a team of approx. 10 OT developers on\-site and manage OT initiatives globally (PLC, embedded C/C\+\+, IPC) for platform and machine?control projects.  
Take co\-ownership of Rieter’s overall strategy for controls and OT platform roadmaps.  
Drive new control concepts together with R\&D, including platform development and control migration roadmap.  
Ensure the further development and reliable operation of existing controls, including modernization and migration paths.  
Work with architecture team to keep our solutions aligned with modern architecture approaches and frameworks.  
Contribute to Rieter’s AI strategy on the shopfloor: define how control systems expose data and services for AI use cases.  
Act as part of the Digital Leadership Team, interfacing with Product Management, IT, Data and Automation on roadmaps and platform decisions.  
Communicate clearly with management and technical stakeholders, represent your domain in steering committees and customer projects.  
Mobility: approx. 5–10% (visits to R\&D teams and production sites)  
Your Qualifications  
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field.  
7\+ years experience in OT/ICS development or industrial automation, including leading projects and teams.  
Proven track record in PLC/IPC?based control projects (e.g. IEC 61131?3, Codesys, B\&R, Siemens, Beckhoff) and embedded C/C\+\+.  
Experience in designing or evolving control architectures – ideally with familiarity to frameworks such as TOGAF, ISA?95/99 or comparable reference models.  
Solid understanding of OT security and safe OT/IT integration.  
First exposure to AI?related topics in industrial environments (e.g. data pipelines for analytics, condition monitoring, optimization), or strong motivation to build these skills.  
Strong leadership and communication skills: able to coach developers, shape direction, and collaborate across R\&D, IT, Data and regional organisations.  
Comfortable working in an international environment (English required, German a plus)

an international working environment with long tradition

title: Electromechanical Engineer - Normal-Conducting Magnets
description:
What you'll do
You will help shape the next generation of normal-conducting accelerator magnets for the Future Circular Collider (FCC), from design and prototyping through industrialisation and system integration. Working with CERN teams and industrial partners, you will develop scalable manufacturing and procurement strategies and apply lessons learned from the testing, maintenance and renovation of existing accelerator magnets to the development and delivery of reliable, cost-effective FCC magnet systems.

Your responsibilities
Design and develop cost-effective normal-conducting magnet technologies for the FCC, from concept and modelling through prototyping and system integration.
Study and propose manufacturing and procurement strategies for FCC magnets, tailored to the scale of the project and targeting an efficient and effective production, installation and maintenance.
Plan, organise and coordinate the maintenance, repair, testing and modification of existing magnets in operation, including specific renovation campaigns, applying the experience gained to the development of FCC magnets.
Prepare technical specifications, reports and other engineering documentation, and communicate technical results to relevant stakeholders.

Your profile
Experience in the design or construction of accelerator magnets or comparable complex electromechanical equipment.
Experience in analysing mechanical or magnetic measurements and using them to validate and improve designs.
Experience in the procurement of magnets or similar equipment, either in industry or in a laboratory, would be an asset.
Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of mechanical or electrical engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Design and modelling of normal conducting magnets and permanent magnet systems.
Operation and maintenance of normal conducting magnet systems.
Design and analysis of mechanical structures.
Knowledge and application of magnetic materials, and electric insulations.

Medical hazard
Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain conditions.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

Employment conditions
Interventions in underground installations.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Work in Radiation Areas.
Operations on low or high voltage electrical installations or in their vicinity requiring a specific authorisation.

For more information please visit: https://careers.cern/jobs/electromechanical-engineer-normal-conducting-magnets/

title: Customer Success & IT Project Manager 80-100 %
description:
Die proaktive und professionelle Betreuung, Begleitung und Beratung von Kunden ist deine Passion? Du liebst es, Dreh\- und Angelpunkt zu sein und Veränderungen voranzutreiben? Du möchtest etwas bewegen und Unmögliches möglich machen? Dann werde jetzt Teil der Open Circle Crew und begleite unsere Kunden auf dem Weg der digitalen Transformation! Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung suchen wir dich (m/w/d) für unser Customer Success\-Team!  
Interessiert? Bewirb dich gerne hier: /  
(Junior) Customer Success \& IT Project Manager 80\-100 %  
Deine Herausforderungen  
Das Customer Success\-Team ist – neben unserer Service Desk, die sich Störungen und dringenden Problemen annimmt – Dreh\- und Angelpunkt zwischen Open Circle und unserer vielfältigen Kundenlandschaft. Unser Ziel ist die professionelle und umfassende Betreuung der Kundschaft. Als Customer Success Manager wirst du für ein ausgewähltes Kundenportfolio diese zentrale Funktion wahrnehmen und «deine» Kunden in der Weiterentwicklung ihrer IT begleiten. Als IT Projektleiterin/Projektleiter führst du IT\-Projekte für unsere Kunden auf Basis unserer Swiss Business Cloud und weiteren Partner\-Services. Die Projekte umfassen etwa das initiale Onboarding neuer Kunden oder die Erweiterung von Services und Systemen bei bestehenden Kunden.  
Für dein Kundenportfolio bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für Business\-Themen und die Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Open Circle. Dabei repräsentierst du gegenüber den Kunden unser Unternehmen und unsere Werte.  
Du betreust deine Kunden proaktiv, führst regelmässig Relationship Review\-Meetings durch und pflegst eine partnerschaftliche, auf Langfristigkeit ausgerichtete Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe. Dabei verantwortest du deine Kunden in allen Belangen (Verträge und SLA, kommerziell, Zufriedenheit, etc.). Dafür hast du ein starkes und schlagkräftiges Team im Rücken, welches stets zur Unterstützung beigezogen werden kann.  
Du verstehst das Geschäft unserer Kunden und bringst ihre Bedürfnisse mit unserer Produkt\- und Dienstleistungspalette in Einklang. Dabei nimmst du neue Bedürfnisse entgegen und bearbeitest diese je nach Umfang und Technologie\-Know\-how selber oder koordinierst die Beratung und Umsetzung mit unseren Engineers und Projektleitern.  
Du arbeitest mit Führungskräften und Entscheidungsträgern aus verschiedenen Branchen wie auch mit Projektleitern, Kundenberatern und Technikern von uns und unseren Partnerfirmen zusammen.  
Du stellst die Rapportierung und Verrechnung der Projekte sicher und erledigst auch die administrativen Arbeiten gründlich und pflichtbewusst.  
Du stehst im engen Austausch mit dem Chief Customer Officer und transportierst Kundenrückmeldungen in unser Unternehmen zurück, um unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen noch besser zu machen.  
Du übernimmst den Lead in IT\-Projekten und leitest diese selbstständig. Du moderierst, organisierst, koordinierst und kommunizierst. Du bist der Taktgeber des Vorhabens und verantwortest dieses in Sachen Kosten, Termin und Qualität.  
Du ermittelst und klärst die Kundenbedürfnisse und arbeitest Projekt\-Vereinbarungen aus  
Du arbeitest gerne und eng mit Kunden, Partnern und unseren Kundenberatern, System Engineers und Entwicklern zusammen. Der “OSI\-Layer 8” – also der Mensch – ist deine Passion.  
Es macht dir Spass, mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen zusammenzuarbeiten.  
Durch deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe findest du einfache und pragmatische Lösungen für alle Beteiligten. Dabei brennst du darauf, der Komplexität die Einfachheit abzugewinnen.  
Dich begeistern IT\- und Cloud\-Technologien und kannst diese geschickt einsetzen.  
Für dich ist Veränderung die einzige gewünschte Konstante.  
Was du mitbringen solltest  
Du kannst dich mit unseren Core Values identifizieren und bist bereit, dein tägliches Handeln an diesen auszurichten  
Du bringst eine solide Grundausbildung im Bereich Informatik mit (Lehre im Bereich Systemtechnik / System Engineering / Plattformentwicklung). Idealerweise hast du eine Weiterbildung in Informatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik bereits abgeschlossen, bist aktuell daran oder beabsichtigst, sie in naher Zukunft zu absolvieren.  
Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und konntest bereits praktische Erfahrung in einer Funktion mit aktivem B2B\-Kundenkontakt sammeln (z. B. in einer vergleichbaren Funktion, als Projektleiter, als Berater, als Key Account Manager mit IT\-technischem Bezug, oder ähnliches).  
Kenntnisse aus dem IT\-Betrieb, besser IT\-Outsourcing und Cloud, sind von Vorteil.  
Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von Microsoft Windows und Office, «Digital Native» mit einer präzisen und sauberen elektronischen Arbeitsweise.  
Ein ausgeprägtes Kundenverständnis gepaart mit hohem Verantwortungs\- und Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie Zuverlässigkeit zeichnen dich aus.  
Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, für unsere Kunden die Extrameile zu gehen.  
Fundierte Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse.  
Weiterbildung(en) oder Zertifizierung(en) im Bereich Projektmanagement sind ein Plus aber kein Muss / du hast Bereitschaft, eine solche zu erlangen.  
Erfahrung in der Leitung von (Teil\-) Projekten in einem vergleichbaren Umfeld; Kenntnisse aus dem IT\-Betrieb, besser IT\-Outsourcing und/oder Cloud erwünscht.  
Aufgeschlossene und sympathische Art mit gepflegtem, selbstsicherem und authentischem Auftreten sowie ausgezeichnete Umgangsformen.  
Analytische Fähigkeiten, Verkaufs\- und Verhandlungsgeschick sowie Problemlösungskompetenz.

Was dich erwartet  
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deinen Produktbereich und gestaltest dessen fachliche und kommerzielle Entwicklung aktiv mit.  
Dabei…  
betreust und entwickelst du einen wichtigen Sortimentsbereich unseres Petcare\-Portfolios mit Schwerpunkt Tierernährung und therapeutische Diäten.

pflegst und entwickelst du die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Lieferanten und Industriepartnern und koordinierst die relevanten Themen rund um deinen Produktbereich.

arbeitest du eng mit unseren internationalen Industriepartnern sowie internen Schnittstellen zusammen und bringst Kunden\- und Marktfeedback in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Sortiments ein.

Wir suchen nicht den einen perfekten Lebenslauf. Entscheidend ist für uns, dass du fachliches Interesse an Tierernährung mit kommerziellem Denken verbindest.

ein Studium der Veterinärmedizin, Tierernährung, Tierwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare fachliche Qualifikation und Interesse daran, dich im Product Management weiterzuentwickeln,

Gemeinsam neue Massstäbe setzen und die Zukunft gestalten \- das bedeutet für uns mehr, als Aufgaben einfach abzuarbeiten. Hier arbeitest du mit Menschen zusammen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, hohe Ansprüche haben und den Mut mitbringen, neue Wege zu gehen. Bei uns findest du ein Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen und Leistung Hand in Hand gehen und deine Ideen, deine Initiative und dein Beitrag zählen. So hast du die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, dein Team und deine persönliche Entwicklung.  
Was du bewirkst  
Beratung \& Betreuung mit Weitblick: Du begleitest Privat\- und Firmenkunden in allen Versicherungsfragen mit echtem Engagement und sicherst massgeschneiderte Lösungen für jedes individuelle Bedürfnis. Als Kundenberater:in bist du da, wenn es darauf ankommt.  
Langfristige Beziehungen aufbauen: Vertrauen steht im Zentrum deiner Arbeit \- du pflegst und entwickelst nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen, die auf deinem exzellenten Service beruhen.  
Wachstum aktiv gestalten: Du hast ein gutes Netzwerk und bringst deine Energie in die Akquise neuer Kundinnen und Kunden ein. Dein Engagement sorgt dafür, dass unser Kundenstamm beständig wächst. Wie können wir dich hierbei unterstützen? Indem du einen eigenen Kundenstamm mit Privat\- und Firmenkunden erhältst.  
Marketing\- \& Vertriebsunterstützung: Mit frischen Ideen unterstützt du unsere Marketingaktionen, besuchst Messen und Veranstaltungen, um unser Netzwerk zu stärken.  
Immer am Puls der Zeit: Durch unsere Grundausbildung und kontinuierliche Weiterbildungen bleibst du fachlich auf dem neuesten Stand und bietest höchste Beratungskompetenz.  
Was du mitbringst  
Erfahrung \& Expertise: Du bringst Erfahrung in der Kundenberatung oder im Verkauf mit \- optimalerweise in der Finanz\- oder Versicherungsbranche. Auch ambitionierte Quereinsteiger:innen, die bereit sind durchzustarten sind herzlich willkommen.  
Kommunikationstalent: Menschen begeistern und gewinnen \- das liegt dir im Blut. Du glänzt durch Kommunikations\- und Verhandlungsstärke. Du kannst als Kundenberater:in überzeugend argumentieren und verfügst über stilsichere Deutschkenntnisse.  
Dienstleistung ist deine Stärke: Der Aussendienst ist deine Leidenschaft und deine hohe Kundenorientierung sowie Servicebereitschaft zeichnen dich aus.  
Engagement \& Eigeninitiative: Mit überdurchschnittlicher Motivation und Unternehmergeist bist du bereit, Grosses zu erreichen und Ziele zu übertreffen.  
Regionale Verankerung: Dein Wohnort liegt in der Region Engadin, in welcher du deine Kundinnen und Kunden betreust. Du verfügst über ein starkes Netzwerk in dieser Region und schätzt es, neue Kontakte aufzubauen und zu pflegen.  
Bereit, Kundinnen und Kunden mit Leidenschaft zu begeistern und mit uns zu wachsen? Dann setze dein Talent gezielt ein und bewirb dich jetzt!  
Zusammenarbeit, die etwas bewegt  
Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen wollen. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven helfen uns, bessere Lösungen zu entwickeln \- für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden genauso wie für uns als Team.

Cajus Schuppli

im stationären OP\-Bereich vom Spital Zollikerberg  
Wenn auch Sie den Unterschied im Leben von Menschen machen möchten, sind das Ihre Aufgaben:  
Als Berufsbildner:in betreuen und unterstützen Sie unsere Studierenden während ihrer praktischen Ausbildung und fördern deren fachliche sowie persönliche Entwicklung

Werden Sie Teil des Dienstleistungszentrum Operationssäle und Intensivstation (DLZ OP/IS), welches einen fachlich hochstehenden und effizienten Operationssaalbetrieb sowie die intensivmedizinische Behandlung und Betreuung von Patientinnen und Patienten verantwortet. Jährlich werden mehr als 7'500 ambulante und stationäre Operationen in den Fachgebieten Viszeralchirurgie, Traumatologie, Orthopädie, Gynäkologie und Urologie durchgeführt. Über 1'800 Behandlungstage werden zudem auf der interdisziplinären Intensivstation (6 Betten) erbracht.  
Verschaffen Sie sich in unserem 360° Rundgang einen ersten Eindruck zu Ihrem neuen Arbeitsort.  
Damit Sie sich bei uns wohlfühlen, warten viele Benefits auf Sie. Um nur einige zu nennen:  
Grosszügige finanzielle und zeitliche Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen  
Eigene Pensionskasse mit überobligatorischer Beteiligung der Arbeitgeberin  
Ökobonus von bis zu CHF 650\.\- pro Jahr  
Kostenlose Nutzung des Fitness\-Raumes auf dem Areal

hier. Wenn auch Sie die beste Version Ihrer Selbst sein möchten, finden Sie bei uns die Möglichkeiten dazu.

Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachmann / Fachfrau Operationstechnik OT HF (z.B. dipl. Pflegefachperson FA OP)

Hohes Qualitäts\- und Dienstleistungsverständnis  
Verantwortungsbewusste und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit  
Nähere Auskünfte erteilt Ihnen gerne Micaela Lorenzi, Leiterin Instrumentierpflege, T .  
Bitte bewerben Sie sich über unser Online\-Tool.  
Wir möchten diese Position mit Direktbewerbungen besetzen, ohne die Unterstützung durch Personalberatungen. Herzlichen Dank im Voraus für das Verständnis.  
Über das Spital Zollikerberg SZB01 \#LI\-PZ1  
Wir stehen für ein umfassendes Leistungsangebot und starke Kooperationspartner. Mit öffentlichem Leistungsauftrag und 173 Betten trägt das Spital Zollikerberg zur optimalen medizinischen Versorgung des Grossraumes Zürich bei. Bei uns dürfen sich jährlich mehr als 11'000 stationäre und 75'000 ambulante Patient:innen aller Versicherungsklassen wohl und in guten Händen fühlen. Unsere breit aufgestellte Grundversorgung umfasst Inneren Medizin, Gynäkologie und Geburtshilfe mit Neonatologie, allgemeinen Chirurgie, ein interdisziplinäres Notfallzentrum sowie Orthopädie mit spezialisierter Wirbelsäulenchirurgie.

Aus\- und Weiterbildung  
Wir investieren in die Entwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden. Ein breites internes Bildungsangebot steht allen offen, und wir unterstützen externe Weiterbildungen.  
Attraktive Ferienregelung  
Unsere Ferienregelung garantiert allen Mitarbeitenden mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien. Für Lernende und Mitarbeitende unter 20 Jahren sind es 6 Wochen. Zudem ist der Bezug von unbezahltem Urlaub möglich.

description:
(Senior) Bioanalytical Principal Investigator LBS / GLP Study Director (100%)  
Shape the future of bioanalysis for innovative medicines  
Celerion is a leading global contract research organization (CRO) specializing in early clinical research and bioanalytical services. For more than 40 years, we have partnered with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide to accelerate the development of new therapies and bring life\-changing medicines to patients faster.  
To support the continued growth of our Bioanalytical Laboratory in Fehraltorf (Zurich area), Switzerland, we are looking for a motivated and scientifically driven professional to join our Ligand Binding Services (LBS) team as a:  
(Senior) Bioanalytical Principal Investigator LBS / GLP Study Director (100%)  
In this role, you will take scientific and operational ownership of regulated bioanalytical studies and method validations. You will serve as the primary client contact, lead study execution from planning through reporting, and play a key role in delivering high\-quality data to support drug development programs worldwide.  
Your Responsibilities  
Study Leadership \& Scientific Oversight  
Lead and oversee GLP/GxP\-compliant bioanalytical studies and method validations within the Ligand Binding Services (LBS) department.  
Act as Study Director and/or Principal Investigator with full responsibility for assigned studies or study phases.  
Develop and approve study plans, validation protocols, analytical reports and associated study documentation.  
Review, evaluate and approve analytical data to ensure scientific integrity and regulatory compliance.  
Ensure all study activities are conducted in accordance with applicable SOPs, regulatory requirements and client expectations.  
Client Management  
Serve as the primary scientific and operational contact for assigned clients.  
Provide regular project updates and maintain strong communication throughout the study lifecycle.  
Support client meetings, scientific discussions and audits as required.  
Operational Excellence  
Coordinate laboratory activities and ensure efficient study execution.  
Train, mentor and support assigned laboratory personnel.  
Contribute to process improvements and continuous enhancement of laboratory operations and quality standards.  
Support bioanalytical data management activities and documentation review processes.  
Additional Responsibilities for Senior\-Level Candidates  
Lead complex or strategic client programs.  
Provide scientific mentoring and guidance to junior Principal Investigators and laboratory staff.  
Act as a subject expert for ligand\-binding and cell\-based assay technologies.  
Contribute to business development activities, client presentations and scientific initiatives.﻿  
Your Profile  
﻿Required Qualifications  
Degree in Biochemistry, Biology, Chemistry or a related scientific discipline; PhD is advantageous.  
Minimum 2 years of experience in bioanalysis or quantitative analytical sciences.  
Hands\-on experience with ligand\-binding assays and/or cell\-based assays.  
Experience working in a regulated environment (GLP, GCP, GMP and/or ISO standards).  
Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.  
Ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.  
Preferred Qualifications  
Previous experience as a Study Director, Principal Investigator or equivalent scientific leadership role.  
Knowledge of biomarker, pharmacokinetic (PK), immunogenicity (ADA) or biologics bioanalysis.  
Good German language skills.  
Experience working directly with pharmaceutical or biotechnology clients.  
What We Offer  
The opportunity to lead scientifically challenging projects for global pharmaceutical and biotech clients.  
Exposure to innovative biologics, biomarkers and emerging therapeutic modalities.  
A collaborative, international and science\-driven working environment.  
Structured onboarding and continuous professional development opportunities.  
Modern laboratories and state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure.

A workplace located near Zurich with easy access to excellent public transportation and recreational opportunities.

At Celerion, you will contribute directly to the development of new medicines while working alongside highly skilled scientists in a dynamic and supportive environment. We value scientific excellence, teamwork, integrity and innovation, and we are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed.  
Celerion is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

title: Cyber Security Specialist
description:

Cyber Security Specialist  
Du suchst nach einer spannenden Herausforderung im Cyber Security Umfeld und möchtest den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere machen? Willkommen bei EveryWare!  
So schaffst du Mehrwert  
Als Cyber Security Specialist überwachst du die Infrastrukturen von EveryWare Kunden auf verdächtige Aktivitäten und Anomalien und analysierst Security Events. Bei Security Incidents ergreifst du Erstmassnahmen zur Eindämmung von Cyber Angriffen und führst weiterführende Analysen durch. Um den kontinuierlichen Betrieb des EveryWare SOC zu ermöglichen unterhältst du die Cyber Security Infrastruktur und entwickelst sie weiter. Dabei ist die Zusammenarbeit mit Engineers aus verschiedenen Teams gleichermassen wichtig wie die Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit mit den Kunden. Deine neue Aufgabe umfasst folgende Tätigkeiten:  
Analyse von Sicherheitsereignissen und Ergreifen von Erstmassnahmen zur Eindämmung von Cyber Angriffen  
Security Incident Response und vertiefte Analyen des Schadensausmasses  
Weiterentwicklung der Security Incident Handling und Response Prozesse  
Unterhalt und Weiterentwicklung der Cyber Security Infrastruktur  
Weiterentwicklung der Cyber Defence Services (Service Portfolio, Automatisierung, Verbesserung der Prozesse)  
Erstellen von Schwachstellen\-Berichten und besprechen der Resultate mit den Engineering Teams und den Kunden  
Unterstützung von Engineers und Kunden in Fragen der Cyber Sicherheit  
Teaminterner Know\-How Transfer  
Das zeichnet dich aus  
Du hast als Security Analyst bereits Erfahrungen mit Schwachstellen und Security Alert Management und bist vertraut mit der Analyse, Aggregation und Korrelation von verschiedenen Informationen. Dich zeichnet ein hohes Mass an Integrität aus und IT\-Sicherheit ist dir ein zentrales Anliegen. Um in dieser spannenden Position erfolgreich zu sein, bringst du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

Erfahrungen mit Tools und Produkten folgender Art sind ein Pluspunkt: Splunk, Yara, Sigma, SOAR, Microsoft Azure

Du bist wissbegierig, willst dich im Bereich Cyber Security weiterentwickeln und hast ein Gespür und Verständnis für die Business Prozesse der Kunden  
Du willst über den Tellerrand eines klassischen Security Analysts hinausschauen  
Dein Wissen teilst du gerne mit anderen, bist offen und interessiert an kollektivem Lernen

Ein technisches Studium oder eine technische Aus\- und Weiterbildung.  
Wer braucht deine Verstärkung?

Technische Begeisterung trifft auf umfassende Expertise. Hier profitierst du von einem Erfahrungsschatz und einem hochprofessionellen Netzwerk.

Du findest bei uns ein Arbeitsumfeld, das sich permanent den Anforderungen des Marktes und der Kunden anpasst. Daher erwarten dich viele interne sowie externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

Help our clients successfully manage global challenges

Our Swiss market-leading FSI Deal Transformation and Post-Merger Integration Team advises Swiss Corporate and mid-market clients to generate and create value from their Mergers & Acquisitions, Divestitures, and Carve-outs. With a dedicated team of FSI experts, we deliver integration and separation advisory services, leading complex engagements with our clients, and deploying deep functional expertise in finance, human resources, commercial, and technology.

M&A Integration and Separation leadership: bring a forward-looking approach and tailored methodologies to client situations, to lead complex M&A separations and integrations.
M&A value creation: perform and oversee operational and financial analysis to assess synergies, the impact and complexities of carve-outs, and the stand-alone performance improvement potential of buyouts and corporate divestments.

C-suite intimacy: develop your ability to lead conversations with client CXOs, articulating ideas into tangible solutions, and becoming the client’s go-to contact for delivery transformation.

Team leadership and development: inspire and guide team members to achieve their full potential, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and excellence in project execution.
Analytical and AI solutions: provide strategic insights, advice and deploy advanced analytical and AI solutions.

Who we are looking for

Demonstrated FSI experience, entrepreneurial mindset, self-starter attitude, highly motivated to lead and grow, with ability to work independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with tight deadlines and evolving priorities.
Strong problem-solving capabilities with a focus on strategic decision-making and attention to detail, alongside a proven ability to simplify complex concepts, create executive-level narratives, and synthesise value effectively.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from top-tier universities with exceptional academic marks.
Minimum of 7 years of relevant M&A experience in consulting or industry roles, with clear experience in one of our main sectors, i.e., banking, wealth management, and insurance.  
Strong acumen for project and stakeholder management, with high-quality skills in Excel, PowerPoint and executive storytelling.
Aptitude with AI technologies and a keen interest in embedding AI solutions into our offerings to enhance client outcomes and drive innovation.
Fluent in English, with excellent interpersonal skills and experience working within an international community. Language proficiency in German is desired.

description:

Job description:  
As an HR Business Analyst – Workday HCM, you will support the day\-to\-day operation and continued development of the organisation's HR systems, with a strong focus on Workday HCM.

Analytical, organised and proactive, with strong attention to detail and a customer\-focused approach.

Broader knowledge of HR service delivery, HR compliance and GDPR.

title: Executive Assistant - LE4 - DFAT - Geneva
description:
Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
Application Deadline: August 26, 2026\.  
Department: DFAT \- Geneva.  
Employment Type: Permanent \- Full Time.  
Location: Australian Permanent Mission, Geneva  
Workplace: Onsite  
Compensation and Benefits: CHF 95,784 / yeat, 20 days annual leave, 50% employer contribution to health insurance and accident insurance, and to a retirement fund.  
Applications are sought from persons interested in employment within the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva.  
The successful applicant will be engaged as a locally engaged staff member by the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva.  
Please be advised that the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva does not assist with relocation. Any costs associated with taking up the position would be the responsibility of the successful candidate.  
A standard probity check will be undertaken prior to commencement for the successful applicant.  
Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
About The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade  
The role of the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) is to advance the interests of Australia and Australians internationally. This involves strengthening Australia’s security, enhancing Australia’s prosperity, delivering an effective and high\-quality overseas aid program and helping Australian travellers and Australians overseas. The department provides foreign, trade and development policy advice to the Australian Government. DFAT also works with other Australian Government agencies to drive coordination of Australia’s pursuit of global, regional and bilateral interests.  
About the Position  
Under direction, the Executive Assistant to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador provides high\-level executive, administrative and organisational support at the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva. The position also organises official events and functions.  
Due to the sensitive nature of the work involved, this position will need to be able to hold and maintain a national security clearance recognised by DFAT.  
Key responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to:  
Provide high\-level executive support to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador, ensuring the effective operation of executive offices in a fast\-paced and sensitive environment.  
Manage and prioritise correspondence, invitations, briefing materials and requests, exercising sound judgement to determine priority, action and compliance requirements.  
Coordinate official visits and delegation programs for Ministers, senior officials and high\-level visitors, balancing competing priorities and operational requirements.  
Plan and deliver representational events, meetings and official engagements, liaising with internal and external stakeholders to achieve Mission objectives.  
Manage representational expenditure and financial administration, including forecasting, acquittals, reconciliations and reporting in accordance with DFAT policies and procedures.  
Coordinate travel, logistics and related administrative arrangements for executive leadership and official activities, ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures.  
Monitor security, operational and workflow risks, implementing required controls and escalating issues as appropriate.  
Provide administrative guidance, maintain effective business systems and support team coordination, contributing to continuous improvement and organisational effectiveness.  
Required Qualifications/Experience/Knowledge/Skills  
Proven experience in similar Executive Assistant role/s  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
Ability to work with and support a team. Ability to develop and maintain respectful and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders  
Ability to manage time, prioritise, plan, handle multiple tasks and work well under pressure  
Financial management and organisational skills  
Discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential information  
Extensive experience using Microsoft Office and electronic applications  
Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills  
Fluency in English is required, with fluency in French highly regarded  
Knowledge of, or an ability to quickly acquire a knowledge of Australian Government legislation or departmental policy and guidelines in relation to the position duties  
Desirable  
Previous experience working in an embassy, international organisation, or comparable environment.  
Security Requirements  
Australian NV2 security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain this. Therefore applicants must hold Australian citizenship to be considered.  
Please note that candidates who hold citizenship or dual citizenship of Switzerland are not eligible for an Australian Security Clearance.  
How to Apply  
Where the application form asks for a cover letter, please provide a written pitch of no more than 500 words demonstrating your suitability to perform the key responsibilities of the position. Your pitch is your opportunity to tell us why you are the right candidate for the role. It will be assessed on your ability to demonstrate, or have the potential to develop, the required skills, knowledge, experience and qualifications to proficiently perform the role. Relevant examples and accomplishments will strengthen your application. Please attach a copy of your pitch with your CV.  
The Fair Work Act 2009 is not intended to apply to the employment of Locally Engaged Staff (LES) at Australia’s overseas diplomatic and consular missions. The successful candidate’s terms and conditions of employment will be governed by the laws of Switzerland.

title: Residential Assistant Houseparent
description:
Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified

Residential Assistant Houseparent

to join the school from: 08.01.2027

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.
Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 06.09.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.
Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE
This is a live-in residential position where the post holder will be responsible for the safeguarding, welfare and security of students in conjunction with the Houseparent (HP) and House team.
The job may involve any or all of the following specifications. Above all, there is an expectation of a RAHP who is generous with their time and responsive to the needs of the students. The list is neither  definitive nor exhaustive and the range of tasks will embrace many incidents and situations which are not stated, but require initiative and common sense to be applied.

The post requires someone who likes and understands young people and is able to demonstrate good sense. They should have good personal interactive skills with young people and their parents and guardians by being a good listener, flexible in outlook, reliable, warm and friendly in disposition, with sufficient sensitivity to show tact and diplomacy. A sense of humour and an even temper dealing with all situations in a co-operative and sensitive manner are also fundamental to carrying out this job effectively.

The nature of the work requires physical fitness and a good level of stamina. It is understood that each House may have a slightly different structure for the job, depending upon the particular circumstances, strengths and skills of the individual post holders. The role will vary according to whether the RAHP works in a junior or senior House, usually working 4 out of 5 weekday afternoons with one full day off during the week. In addition, there are two evening duties, with accompanying overnights on call. Weekend commitments are approximately 2 out of 3 weekends, with some tutor support at various times over the weekend.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The role of the RAHP can cover a variety of responsibilities, including:
General residential support
Acting as a tutor for a small group of students, providing them with individual guidance and support in both academic and pastoral areas
Supporting teaching or coaching staff, for example in drama, music, sport, expeditions or another area of specialist interest and competence

General duties in the House will include
Assisting the Houseparent in promoting the welfare and security of students and the smooth running of the House
Working as part of the wider House team
Residential and administrative work in the House
Weekday supervision in House
Weekend duties
Morning and evening duties in the House
Overnight supervision in the House as required
Various boarding and school supervision duties as required
Study supervision
Assistance with the co-curricular programme
Attendance at training and support meetings as required
To maintain the medicine cabinet and medical records in accordance with Health Centre guidance
To supervise and keep records of students taking medication. All prescribed medication should be administered to students on time according to the prescription timings
Any other duties which may reasonably be required from time to time by the School

Working week
Residential Assistant Houseparents work 4 afternoons and 2 evenings per week. They also work 2 weekends out of 3. A weekend starts once school ends on Friday and ends on Monday morning. They have one weekday off each week which varies across houses based on the timetable of the Houseparent.

An example of a weekday routine
11:55 - 12:05        Handover from House Assistant to RAHP
11:55 - 17:00        RAHP on duty
16:15 - 21:30        Tutor on duty plus RAHP or HP in House (HP x2 and RAHP x2 evenings)
21:30 - 23:00        RAHP or HP on duty (HP x2 and RAHP x2 weekday nights)
23:00 - 07:00        RAHP or HP on overnight call (HP x2 and RAHP x2 weekday nights)

Friday evening and the weekend is staffed by the RAHP or HP on duty for that weekend with some tutor support at various times over the weekend.

In addition to the responsibilities outlined above
It is important that the post holder is always aware of the School’s Safeguarding guidelines and Staff Prudence code, observing an appropriate professional relationship with students that is characterised by effective working and caring relationships.
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably required by the Deputy School Director to assist in the smooth running of the team.
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. All shortlisted applicants will undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

description:

HRM Systems AG mit Sitz in Winterthur ist ein erfolgreiches Familienunternehmen mit 160 Mitarbeitenden und langer Firmengeschichte. Grossunternehmen und Unternehmensgruppen werden bei der Abwicklung von HR\-Prozessen und im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement durch die im Hause entwickelten Softwarelösungen und Dienstleistungen unterstützt. Als Marktleader in ihrem Bereich steht das Unternehmen auf stabilen und finanziell gesunden Beinen. Dies ermöglicht die gezielte Investition in die wegweisende Weiterentwicklung ihrer Produkte. Auf dich warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, grosszügige Home\-Office\-Regelungen, sehr gute Sozialleistungen sowie moderne Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.  
Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.  
Deine Herausforderung  
Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.  
Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.  
Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.  
Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.  
Du bringst technische Konzepte voran und schaffst die Grundlage für eine stabile, sichere und wartungsarme Infrastruktur.  
Du arbeitest mit Technologien und Werkzeugen wie GitLab, OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ELK, Grafana und Nagios.  
Du übernimmst übergreifende Themen wie die Verwaltung von Lizenzen und Zugriffsberechtigungen für Entwickler.  
Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.  
Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen  
Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps oder DevOps\-nahen Umfeld  
Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung (du kommst entweder aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich in Richtung DevOps entwickelt oder du bringst einen Infrastruktur\-Background mit starkem DevOps\-Engineering Verständnis mit)  
Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse von mehreren Technologien, welche sich mit denen bei HRM decken: OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, GitLab  
Du gestaltest gerne mit und bringst deine Ideen ein  
Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem noch nicht alles abschliessend definiert ist, und gehst Themen proaktiv, analytisch und lösungsorientiert an.  
In Deutsch bist du verhandlungssicher

Company Description  
Welcome to SMG Swiss Marketplace Group!  
SMG is a pioneering network of online marketplaces and a leading European digital company that simplifies people’s lives with forward\-looking products.

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you'll be a hands\-on technical leader with company\-level impact across our Real Estate vertical. You’ll shape and evolve the frontend architecture powering our portals, create shared frontend solutions adopted by multiple teams, and orchestrate complex initiatives.  
Meet the team!  
At SMG, our strength lies in our people. Meet the Manager with whom you could work:  
Yuliya Zvolskaya \- Engineering Manager \- LinkedIn  
At a high level, you will:  
Set technical direction for frontend across multiple teams, building alignment among engineers, product managers, designers and senior stakeholders.  
Influence roadmaps, investment decisions, and engineering priorities by connecting frontend strategy to business outcomes, delivery risk and customer impact.  
Defining and driving the culture of engineering excellence, while leading the evolution of our Real Estate frontend architecture to support future requirements, setting and improving SLAs/SLOs and anticipating ripple effects across systems together with other engineers and principals.

Model a healthy feedback culture, helping people navigate tough conversations and conflicts in a constructive, blameless way.  
Challenge and improve team and cross\-team processes, suggesting changes that improve focus, quality, and speed when needed.  
You’ll still write plenty of code, but your impact will be measured just as much by how you multiply the effectiveness of others as by your individual output.  
Your day\-to\-day  
You'll be part of a product team, splitting time about half and half between product delivery and staff responsibilities, depending on the current needs and priorities  
Innovate, design, implement, and deploy frontend\-focused engineering solutions for our products, from discovery to production.  
Build alignment across teams with different goals and constraints, and unblock progress on ambiguous, cross\-cutting initiatives. Step in to create clarity, momentum, and shared ownership when needed.

Identify and surface cross\-cutting technical bottlenecks, such as performance drags in the core user journey or build\-time inefficiencies, and advocate for their resolution at the leadership level.  
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other engineering teams to shape technical strategy and trade\-offs for new features and platform work  
Partner with DevX to co\-develop engineering 'blueprints' and health scorecards, setting the gold standard for what 'good' looks like in our frontend repositories  
Evaluate, prototype, and introduce new frontend technologies and approaches (frameworks, tooling, patterns), document your findings, and drive adoption where they make sense  
Own and evolve the Frontend ADR process, ensuring technical decisions are documented, socialised, and consistently implemented across our organisation  
Guide and review the work of other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, guild, and informal coaching.  
Help the team embrace and leverage AI \& large language models in our engineering workflows and products  
Contribute to and facilitate the frontend guild, tech chats, and other cross\-team knowledge\-sharing formats  
Promote a culture of high\-quality engineering: testing, monitoring with Datadog, observability, security, and operational excellence  
Our Tech Stack  
You’ll work primarily on the frontend, while collaborating with fullstack engineers:  
Frontend: mainly and some React, both with TypeScript as the language of choice. We run a mix of client\-side, server\-side, pre\-rendered, and hybrid web apps  
Backend: and TypeScript, serverless and microservices architecture in a cloud\-based environment using AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, S3, and more)  
Monitoring \& Observability: Mainly Datadog plus logging/alerting best practices  
AI \& Tooling: We actively adopt the latest developments in AI technology and expect you to embrace innovation offered by large language models in your daily work  
Qualifications  
8\+ years of professional experience with the or similar frameworks  
Proven track record of implementing and maintaining automated frontend testing, using tools such as Jest, Vitest, and/or Cypress  
Experience collaborating with designers using Figma ()  
Strong experience building and evolving large\-scale frontend applications in modern JavaScript/TypeScript  
Proven track record of senior technical leadership in a Staff, Lead, or equivalent role: leading complex cross\-team initiatives, aligning diverse stakeholders, influencing decisions without direct authority, and taking responsibility from strategy through rollout and iteration.  
Deep understanding of modern CI/CD for frontend, including automated release strategies and feature flagging in a microfrontend environment.  
Demonstrated experience creating and driving adoption of shared frontend solutions (e.g. design system components, shared libraries, cross\-cutting tooling)  
Demonstrated experience influencing multiple teams or an entire product area, including driving alignment, adoption, and durable technical change across various teams.  
Experience mentoring senior engineers or tech leads, and raising the technical bar through coaching, feedback, and role modelling.  
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with Engineering\- and Product leadership, as well as non\-technical partners.  
Evidence of defining a technical strategy and turning it into execution across teams.  
Excellent English communication skills, spoken and written.  
You can explain complex topics clearly to different audiences in an international team setting  
We value engineers who:  
Thrive in collaborative environments and are true team players  
Have a growth mindset and are curious, we love growing together  
Are passionate about frontend architecture and building \& scaling cloud\-based solutions  
Are open to change and able to propose pragmatic solutions, not just point out problems

Solid hands\-on experience building production applications with Vue 3

Prior working experience with APIs and microservices and how frontend apps best integrate with them  
Prior working experience with cloud service providers like AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud experience with server\-side rendering / hybrid rendering patterns and edge / CDN optimisation  
Experience integrating frontends with AWS Lambda

title: HR Generalist, EMEA
description:
HR Generalist, EMEA  
vVARDIS is a Swiss\-based oral health company founded by Dr. Haleh and Dr. Golnar Abivardi, dentists, innovators, and award\-winning entrepreneurs. vVARDIS is the result of a combined 30 years of dental and entrepreneurial experience, and 20 years of laboratory and clinical research paired with the creative vision of its founders.  
At vVARDIS, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that enhance oral health and well\-being, inspired by the vision of our founders to foster preventive rather than reparative dentistry. At the heart of our Company lies its patented, revolutionary biomimetic peptide technology. Scientifically proven in over 200 publications, this unique technology can treat early caries through enamel regeneration, like no other technology can do, offering a non\-invasive, pain\-free solution for patients of all ages. We offer a number of oral health products targeting dental professionals and their patients, as well as consumers, all based on our proprietary technology.  
We value our people and believe in fostering a positive and collaborative work environment, based on our core values of innovation, excellence, integrity, and empathy.  
We are located in Zug, Switzerland, with operations across Europe and the US. Join us on this exciting journey!  
Position Overview  
We are seeking a hands\-on HR Generalist to support the Director Human Resources in the day\-to\-day HR operations across our EMEA markets, starting with Switzerland, the UK, and Italy, and expanding as the company grows. This is a generalist role suited to someone who builds and improves processes rather than simply administering them — you'd rather fix a broken process than complain about it. You're comfortable holding direct, constructive conversations with managers when needed, while remaining approachable and collaborative.  
The role also includes acting as payroll deputy for the UK, Switzerland, and Italy, ensuring continuity when the primary contact for our external payroll providers is unavailable. The role reports directly to the Director, Human Resources, with close day\-to\-day collaboration on HR and payroll matters. We work mostly from the office — 60% a week on site, 40% remote.  
Key Responsibilities  
Payroll Deputy — UK, Switzerland \& Italy: Act as back\-up for payroll processing across the three countries, maintaining accurate documentation and liaising with external payroll providers and authorities as required.  
HR Operations \& Process Building: Build and continuously improve core HR processes (onboarding, leave, records, policies) and maintain accurate, compliant personnel records across our EMEA locations. Some of this still needs to be built from the ground up — you're comfortable turning a blank page into a working process.  
Employee Relations \& Manager Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and managers on HR matters, mediate disputes and handle grievances fairly, and promote a respectful, open workplace culture.  
Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment: Manage end\-to\-end recruitment — job postings, sourcing, interviewing, offers, and onboarding — in close collaboration with hiring managers.  
Performance Management: Run a simple, effective performance review process and coach managers on delivering direct, fair feedback.  
Compensation \& Benefits: Support payroll processing with our external providers and administer employee benefits across EMEA, helping define pay structures that are fair, competitive, and easy to administer.  
Compliance \& HR Best Practices: Ensure compliance with employment law across the UK, Switzerland, Italy, and other EMEA markets, escalating regulatory changes and labor law challenges to external counsel where needed.  
Training \& Development: Organize onboarding and practical, ongoing learning support for employee development.  
Qualifications \& Skills  
Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.  
3–5 years in an HR generalist or HR Manager role, ideally within a scale\-up or fast\-growing organization.  
Practical knowledge of payroll and employment law fundamentals in at least one of the UK, Switzerland, or Italy — you don't need to be a lawyer or payroll specialist, but you know when to bring one in.  
Proven ability to build and improve HR processes from the ground up.  
A clear, calm communicator who remains professional and approachable, including in demanding situations.  
Fluent in English and German and/or Italian an advantage given our presence in Switzerland and Italy.  
Proficient with HR/payroll software and HRIS tools.  
vVARDIS is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons.  
Join vVARDIS: If this role is not suitable to your experience or career goals but you wish to stay connected to learn more about vVARDIS and our career opportunities, join the vVARDIS Network on LinkedIn: /  
If you don't hear from us, please know that we highly value your interest in vVARDIS and encourage you to stay connected for future opportunities. jpid26d0925jm jit0833jm jiy26jm

title: Senior Researcher & Lecturer Midwifery and Reproductive Health 80-100%
description:
Senior Researcher \& Lecturer Midwifery and Reproductive Health 80\-100%  
Combine research and teaching at MSc level, and actively shape the future of midwifery science. In this role, you will strengthen evidence\-based care, promote knowledge transfer and contribute to the further development of a young academic profession.  
Senior Researcher \& Lecturer Midwifery and Reproductive Health 80\-100%  
School:  
School of Health Professions

Immediately or by arrangement  
Your role  
In this role you will:  
Design, secure funding for, coordinate, contribute to and lead research and development projects in midwifery and sexual and reproductive health. You will liaise closely with the head of the research unit, take responsibility for project budgets and lead project teams.  
Help shape the strategic development of the research \& development unit and strengthen the internal and external knowledge transfer as well as the national and international visibility of the institute. This will be reflected in your interdisciplinary collaboration, scientific publications, conference presentations and accessible science communication.  
Take responsibility for modules within the MSc Midwifery programme. You will design, plan, deliver, evaluate and ensure the quality of profession\-specific and interprofessional modules. To that end, you will develop scientifically sound module objectives, teaching content, didactic formats and assessment methods at EQF level 7\.  
Teach classes in the MSc Midwifery programme and, where required, in the BSc Midwifery. You will systematically integrate the latest research findings, blended learning, e\-learning and the considered use of artificial intelligence into your teaching and learning environments.  
Provide expert guidance to students on their master's theses, develope and evaluate assessments, and conduct resit examinations in accordance with the applicable quality and AI guidelines.  
Support the programme director in the strategic, organisational, curricular and didactic development of the MSc Midwifery programme. You will contribute to the further development of module curricula, quality assurance and AI integration, and actively represent the programme within the professional community.  
Your profile  
You hold a PhD in midwifery, psychology, health sciences, social sciences or a related field. Your scientific expertise focuses on midwifery care and/or sexual and reproductive health.  
You have successfully developed, secured funding for, conducted and led research projects, and are experienced in project planning, coordination and implementation.  
You have proven expertise in quantitative research methods and confidently apply health or social science methods, with nuance and a strong commitment to quality.  
You have experience in higher education teaching, ideally at master's level, and have completed a continuing education qualification in higher education didactics or a comparable qualification.  
The following would be advantageous:  
A recognised midwifery qualification as well as a sound understanding of the field's professional practice and current challenges facing the profession.  
Several years of professional experience as a midwife or other relevant professional experience outside the higher education sector.  
Enthusiasm for creatively developing and implementing innovative research projects, teaching formats and sustainable solutions.  
Experience in inter\- and transdisciplinary collaboration, as well as the willingness to productively combine different profession\-specific and practice\-based perspectives.  
This is what we stand for  
Zurich University of Applied Sciences ZHAW is one of Switzerland's largest multidisciplinary universities of applied sciences, with over 14'000 students and 3'400 faculty and staff.  
The ZHAW School of Health Sciences is one of the largest and most renowned centres for education and continuing professional development for health professions in the German\-speaking countries. More than 2,000 students and 300 employees benefit from unique degree and continuing education programmes as well as attractive job opportunities in teaching and research in the heart of Winterthur (Canton of Zurich).  
The Midwifery Research Unit promotes quality in obstetrics and midwifery through applied research and development projects by focusing on the best possible care for women, children and families during pregnancy and childbirth, the postpartum period and breastfeeding. We train midwives as well as the next generation of researchers, and develop innovative, sustainable solutions to ensure the delivery of high\-quality, patient\-centered and evidence\-based care by midwives and interprofessional teams. Another focus area is the promotion of sexual and reproductive health among the population.  
ZHAW is committed to gender\-mixed and diverse teams in order to promote equality, diversity and innovation.
